info.title: Wii U Transfer Tools
info.author: El Diuca
info.description: Install WUP packages via LAN or USB
info.details:
Wii U Transfer Tools is a dark-themed WUP package installer for Aroma designed to install your backups without filling up or constantly removing your SD card.

Key Features:
- Two Installation Sources: Install directly over your local network from a Windows PC (with a dark GUI, live speed monitor, and auto-discovery) or hot-plug a FAT32 USB flash drive into the front ports without disconnecting your rear USB storage.
- Zero-SD Mode (NetFSA): Uses Aroma's Mocha payload and multi-core double buffering to stream packages directly to a temporary folder on your target USB drive or internal NAND, installing and cleaning up automatically. Also includes a classic Direct-Sync SD cache mode.
- Batch Queue: Select and install multiple games, updates, and DLCs in a single run.
- Dual-Screen Native UI: Full 720p TV and 480p GamePad touch support, plus Pro Controller compatibility.

Note: Always unplug FAT32 drives before exiting to the Wii U Menu.

AI use: AI-assisted. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
